answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 18 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in sparrow, checked in ripple, and shale makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 6 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
